title: Pico (clang, permissive)
comment: PERMISSIVE (non-GPL) clang/LLVM replacement for the GPL pico-toolchain (src/arm-gcc). clang.wasm replaces cc1plus (frontend + integrated-as), lld.wasm replaces ld, compiler-rt (Apache-2.0) replaces libgcc, picolibc (BSD) replaces newlib. v0.2.0: a real Arduino-API sketch compiles with clang and links to a genuinely BOOTABLE RP2040 UF2 (clang-assembled boot2 + CRC + the real ArduinoCore-API String/Print, clang-built) — see src/pico-clang/build-core.sh + verify-core-boot.cjs. RP2350 compiles/links but a bootable image still needs the SDK IMAGE_DEF block (docs/CLANG_PICO.md).

core.sources: ArduinoCore-API (Common/Print/String) + arduino-pico stdlib_noniso + core/glue platform layer
